logp.method_description: Lipophilicity of the platinum complexes was quantified as log P (logarithm of the 1-octanol/water partition coefficient). The log P values were determined according to the OECD guideline using a shake-flask method [25], as was previously done with platinum complexes [26–28]. Weighed amounts of platinum compounds were partitioned between an aqueous and a 1-octanol phase. Platinum concentrations in both phases were measured by flameless atomic absorption spectrometry. The partition coefficients were calculated on the basis of these results.
